rubric.role_summary: VP leading Customer Success and Support and building a Professional Services function for a SaaS compliance and security platform, with responsibility for services delivery, retention, support quality, and services financial performance.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
VP leading Customer Success and Support and building a Professional Services function for a SaaS compliance and security platform, with responsibility for services delivery, retention, support quality, and services financial performance.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- 10+ years in SaaS Professional Services, Customer Success, and/or Support, including 5+ years in senior leadership at a high-growth software and/or AI company.
- Experience leading a Professional Services or consulting organization.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Experience hiring, structuring, and developing a Professional Services or consulting organization from scratch.
- Experience taking over an established Customer Success and/or Support organization and driving measurable improvements in retention, efficiency, or quality.
- Track record of owning services revenue and scoping, pricing, and selling professional services engagements, including SOWs, change orders, and renewals.
- Experience using AI tools for team productivity and delivery quality, and experimenting with or building AI-enabled workflows in a services or customer-facing context.
- Experience building processes, implementing tools, and using data to drive decisions.
- Familiarity with compliance and security frameworks and ability to translate them into customer-facing delivery strategies; SOC 2, ISO 27001, and HIPAA are examples, not individually required.
- Familiarity with key platforms in the compliance and security ecosystem; the named platforms are examples, not an all-platforms requirement.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): United States. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Remote candidates must currently be located in one of these areas; remote work does not remove this geographic condition.
